model: Disney Princess Light Up Kick Scooter
description:
Every ride feels a little more magical with colorful Disney Princess graphics leading the way. Whether cruising through the neighborhood, heading to the park, or imagining a fairy-tale journey, this scooter inspires confidence, creativity, and outdoor fun with every glide.
Bright LED light-up wheels and an illuminated deck add extra sparkle to every adventure. The eye-catching lights create a fun look that kids will love, helping every ride feel special while encouraging active play and memorable moments outdoors.
The convenient folding design makes it easy to store at home or bring along for family outings and trips to the park. A durable frame supports riders up to 220 pounds, while the simple rear foot brake provides confident stopping control, helping riders enjoy every adventure with ease.

components.description: Rear Foot Brake: Simple stopping control helps riders stay confident.
